name: Etsy
summary: Etsy's careers site describes video candidate screens to learn about Etsy and the role, then behavioural interviews on your skills, experience and how you solve problems and work with others. Some roles have a take-home assignment you then walk through with the team, including any AI tools you used, and Etsy asks candidates not to use AI tools in live interviews. Engineering candidates commonly report coding and system design interviews as well.
rounds: Candidate screen by video: learn about Etsy and the role, with some first questions
Behavioural interview on your experience, problem-solving and teamwork
Take-home assignment for some roles, then a walkthrough with the team
Technical interviews for engineering roles, such as coding and system design
looks_for: Clear explanation of your approach and tools
Honesty about how you used AI on a take-home

questions.text: Tell me about a time you solved a hard problem with a team.
Tell me about a time you made something better for a small business or independent creator.
covers: Who they were and what they needed

questions.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate and how you resolved it.
Tell me about something you built that you're proud of the craft in.
How would you design search that helps buyers find unique handmade items?
covers: Ranking: relevance, quality and fairness to sellers

questions.text: How would you help new sellers get their first sale?
Walk me through your take-home: your approach, the tools you used and what you'd change.
covers: Tools used, including any AI, and how

questions.text: How would you detect counterfeit or prohibited listings at scale?
How would you design a system that sends sellers a notification when they make a sale?
How do you decide whether a feature is worth building?
covers: The problem and who has it

questions.text: Why do you want to work at Etsy?
covers: What draws you to Etsy's marketplace and mission
What you'd like to work on

questions.text: What questions do you have for us?

tips: Don't use AI tools during live interviews; Etsy asks candidates not to.
If you get a take-home, be ready to explain your approach and any tools you used, including AI.
Use Etsy as a buyer, and look at it from a seller's side, before your interviews.
Prepare behavioural stories about teamwork and problem-solving; Etsy's behavioural round focuses on them.
